1.explanation: We need to add a new `size` prop (e.g. `'default'` | `'large'`) to both the classic (`packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.js`) and the v11 next (`packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/Tabs.js`) implementations of TabList (and forward it to Tab). This will allow applying the appropriate 40 px or 48 px CSS classes. We also need to update the legacy story (`Tabs-story.js`) and the next story (`next/Tabs.stories.js`) to surface the new prop and demonstrate both default and large icon-only examples.
1.bug_scenario: The bug is illustrating that the icon-only Tabs variants (both line and contained) should support two fixed container sizes: 40 px (default) and 48 px (large). The screenshots show the default size wrapping a 16 px icon in a 40 px square, and a “large” variant wrapping a 20 px icon in a 48 px square. Currently there is no `size` prop on the Tabs/TabList components, so users cannot toggle between the two sizes for icon-only tabs.
